RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 5

Both you and the successful candidate are women, making sex discrimination virtually impossible to argue. Raising the panel's gender composition will not help your case and could harm your professional reputation.

For director-level municipal roles, panels frequently weigh stakeholder management, leadership style, and public engagement experience more heavily than technical credentials or years of service. Her consultation background likely aligned better with the municipality’s current strategic priorities.

Rather than questioning the panel's demographics, send a polite follow-up on your request for feedback. Frame it constructively to learn what competencies or priorities set the successful candidate apart, which will serve you better for future executive opportunities.
